rows.text_en: Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries ( Fishing Village and Port Regeneration Division ), 051-773-6048, 6176

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「어촌특화발전 지원 특별법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Special Act on Support for Specialized Development of Fishing Villages and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(간이 공작물) 「어촌특화발전 지원 특별법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제10조제3항제1호에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 간이 공작물”이란 다음 각 호의 공작물을 말한다. <개정 2016. 6. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Simplified Structures) In Article 10, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on Support for Specialized Development of Fishing Villages (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), the term “simplified structures prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to the structures set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended June 23, 2016>
1. Vinyl greenhouse
2. Drying facilities for agricultural and fishery products such as seaweed
3. Aquatic seed culture facility

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 제1호부터 제3호까지의 공작물과 유사한 것으로서 해양수산부장관이 정하여 고시하는 공작물
rows.text_en: 4. Other structures similar to those in subparagraphs 1 through 3, as determined and notified by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries

rows.source_ko: 제3조(시설ㆍ토지 기부신청서) ① 「어촌특화발전 지원 특별법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제20조제1항 및 영 제11조제1항에 따라 시설 또는 토지를 기부하려는 자는 별지 제1호서식의 시설ㆍ토지 기부신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 갖추어 「국유재산법」 제2조제10호의 총괄청, 같은 조 제11호의 중앙관서의 장등 또는 지방자치단체의 장(이하 “재산관리청”이라 한다)에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Application for Donation of Facilities and Land) ① A person who intends to donate facilities or land pursuant to Article 20(1) of the Special Act on Support for Specialized Development of Fishing Villages (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) and Article 11(1) of the Enforcement Decree shall submit the Application for Donation of Facilities and Land in Form No. 1 of the Attached Form, along with the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs, to the supervising agency under Article 2, subparagraph 10 of the State Property Act, the head of a central government agency, etc. under subparagraph 11 of the same Article, or the head of a local government (hereinafter referred to as the “Property Management Agency”).
1. Facility and Land Donation Survey Form No. 2

rows.source_ko: 2. 시설ㆍ토지 무상편입도(축척 1천분의 1) 또는 시설ㆍ토지 무상편입 확정도(시설을 기부하는 경우에는 축척 3천분의 1, 토지를 기부하는 경우에는 축척 1천분의 1)
rows.text_en: 2. Map of the gratuitous incorporation of facilities and land (scale 1:1,000) or map confirming the gratuitous incorporation of facilities and land (scale 1:3,000 in the case of donating facilities, scale 1:1,000 in the case of donating land)

rows.source_ko: ② 재산관리청은 제1항에 따른 신청서를 받으면 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(법인인 경우만 해당한다)를 확인하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Property Management Agency shall verify the certificate of corporate registration (only applicable to corporations) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act .

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따라 시설ㆍ토지 기부신청서를 받은 재산관리청이 해당 시설 또는 토지를 기부받기로 결정한 때에는 별지 제3호서식의 국유ㆍ공유재산 인수증서에 시설ㆍ토지 무상편입도 또는 시설ㆍ토지 무상편입 확정도를 첨부하여 해당 시설ㆍ토지를 기부하려는 자에게 교부하고, 무상기부 사실을 해당 시설 또는 토지의 관할 지방자치단체(재산관리청이 해당 시설 또는 토지를 관할하는 지방자치단체가 아닌 경우로 한정한다) 및 관할 등기소에 각각 통지하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When the property management agency that has received the application for donation of facilities or land pursuant to Paragraph 1 decides to accept the said facilities or land as a donation, it shall deliver the said facilities or land to the person intending to donate them by attaching the map of the gratuitous incorporation of the facilities or land or the map of the confirmed gratuitous incorporation of the facilities or land to the Certificate of Acceptance of State-owned or Public Property in Form No. 3 attached thereto, and notify the local government having jurisdiction over the said facilities or land (limited to cases where the property management agency is not the local government having jurisdiction over the said facilities or land) and the competent registry office of the fact of the gratuitous donation, respectively.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(국유ㆍ공유재산 무상양여 신청서) ① 법 제20조제2항 및 영 제11조제2항에 따라 국유ㆍ공유 시설 또는 토지를 무상으로 양여받으려는 자는 별지 제4호서식의 국유ㆍ공유재산 무상양여 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 해양수산부장관 또는 특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(광역시의 구청장을 말한다. 이하 “시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장”이라 한다)에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Application for Gratuitous Transfer of State-Owned or Public Property) ①Any person who intends to receive a gratuitous transfer of state-owned or public facilities or land pursuant to Article 20 , Paragraph 2 of the Act and Article 11 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an Application for Gratuitous Transfer of State-Owned or Public Property in the form of Annex No. 4, along with the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries or the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, Mayor, County Head, or District Head (referring to the head of a metropolitan city; hereinafter referred to as “Mayor, County Head, or District Head”).
1. Statement of Gratuitous Transfer of State-Owned or Publicly Owned Property (Form No. 5)
2. Location map of facilities or land (scale 1:50,000)
3. Map of gratuitous transfer of state-owned or public property or comparison of old and new (scale 1:1,200 or 1:1,000)

rows.source_ko: ② 해양수산부장관 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제1항에 따른 신청서를 받으면 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 토지대장 및 지적도를 확인하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving an application under Paragraph 1, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries or the mayor, county governor, or district head shall verify the land register and cadastral map through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 국유ㆍ공유재산 무상양여 신청서를 받은 해양수산부장관 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 법 제20조제2항 및 영 제11조제3항에 따라 국유ㆍ공유재산을 무상양여하기로 결정한 때에는 별지 제6호서식의 국유ㆍ공유재산 무상양여증서를 국유ㆍ공유재산 무상양여 신청인에게 교부하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries or the mayor, county governor, or district head who has received an application for the gratuitous transfer of state-owned or public property pursuant to Paragraph 1 decides to transfer state-owned or public property gratuitously pursuant to Article 20 Paragraph 2 of the Act and Article 11 Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, they shall issue a certificate of gratuitous transfer of state-owned or public property in the form of Annex 6 to the applicant for the gratuitous transfer of state-owned or public property.

rows.source_ko: 제5조(토지등 매각 또는 임대 대금의 용도) ① 법 제23조제4항제1호에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 채무”란 어촌특화사업의 시행으로 법 제12조제2항에 따른 어촌특화사업 시행자가 부담하게 된 채무를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Use of proceeds from sale or lease of land, etc.) ①The term “debt prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” in Article 23, Paragraph 4, Subparagraph 1 of the Act refers to a debt incurred by the implementing entity of a specialized fishing village project pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Act as a result of the implementation of a specialized fishing village project.

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제23조제4항제4호에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 용도”란 어촌특화사업의 시행으로 조성된 재산 중 어촌특화시설에 제공되지 아니하는 토지와 그 밖의 물건 등의 매각 또는 임대로 받은 대금의 운용 및 관리 비용으로 사용하는 용도를 말한다.
rows.text_en: ② In Article 23, Paragraph 4, Subparagraph 4 of the Act , “use prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to the use of proceeds received from the sale or lease of land and other items, etc., that are not provided for specialized fishing village facilities among the properties created through the implementation of specialized fishing village projects, for the operating and management costs.

rows.source_ko: 제5조의2(어촌특화지원센터의 지정 신청 등) ① 영 제30조의2제2항에 따른 어촌특화지원센터 지정 신청서는 별지 제7호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 5-2 (Application for Designation of Fishing Village Specialization Support Center, etc.) ①The application for designation of a fishing village specialization support center pursuant to Article 30-2, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 7 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제28조의2제2항제4호에서 “해양수산부령이 정하는 업무”란 다음 각 호의 업무를 말한다.
rows.text_en: ② In Article 28-2, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 4 of the Act , “duties prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to the duties of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 어촌특화사업으로 생산된 제품의 판매ㆍ유통 및 홍보 지원
rows.text_en: 1. Support for the sales, distribution, and promotion of products produced through the specialized fishing village project
2. Education and training for implementers of specialized fishing village projects

rows.source_ko: 3. 어촌특화사업 시행자와 국내ㆍ외 연구기관ㆍ대학 및 기업 간 연계의 지원
rows.text_en: 3. Support for linkages between implementers of specialized fishing village projects and domestic and international research institutions, universities, and companies

rows.source_ko: 4. 국내ㆍ외 어촌자원 및 어촌특화사업에 대한 조사ㆍ분석과 수집 정보의 제공
rows.text_en: 4. Survey and analysis of domestic and international fishing village resources and specialized fishing village projects, and provision of collected information
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 21, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(자기부담 등) ① 법 제31조제1항에 따라 특화어촌위원회가 부담하여야 하는 경비는 어촌특화사업 중 해당 어촌지역 주민의 소득증진을 위하여 시설을 설치하는 데에 드는 총사업비의 20퍼센트에 해당하는 금액을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Self-burden, etc.) ① The expenses to be borne by the Specialized Fishing Village Committee pursuant to Article 31, Paragraph 1 of the Act refer to an amount equivalent to 20 percent of the total project cost for installing facilities to increase the income of residents in the relevant fishing village area among the specialized fishing village projects.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에서 규정한 것 외에 특화어촌위원회가 법 제31조제1항에 따라 부담하여야 하는 경비의 산정방법 등에 관하여는 해당 특별자치도ㆍ시ㆍ군ㆍ구(광역시의 구를 말한다. 이하 같다)의 조례로 정한다. 이 경우 특화어촌위원회의 구역이 둘 이상의 시ㆍ군ㆍ구에 걸치는 경우에는 해당 특화어촌위원회의 주된 사무소의 소재지를 관할하는 시ㆍ군ㆍ구의 조례로 정한다.
rows.text_en: ② Except as otherwise provided in Paragraph 1, the method of calculating expenses, etc., that a Specialized Fishing Village Committee must bear pursuant to Article 31, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be determined by the ordinance of the relevant Special Self-Governing Province, City, County, or District (referring to a District of a Metropolitan City; hereinafter the same applies). In this case, if the area of ​​a Specialized Fishing Village Committee spans two or more City, County, or District, it shall be determined by the ordinance of the City, County, or District having jurisdiction over the location of the principal office of the Specialized Fishing Village Committee .

rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2  omitted
